category_title: At-risk young adolescents exhibiting school refusal, performance anxiety, and rejection of teacher authority
scenario_title: Competitive games in Health and Physical Education
minimal_context: The student is participating in a competitive game with peers during Health and Physical Education.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, it is time for our physical education game. Remember, if you get tagged by the ball, you are out and need to sit on the bench.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even care about this game. I'm just going to get out anyway because I'm not good at it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go ahead and join the group to play.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets tagged during the game) No way, I dodged that! I am not out!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You were tagged. You need to step out now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws a temper tantrum, yelling and kicking the wall) It's not fair! I'm not out! I'm never playing with any of you again!
